[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/45164767/11ea258a7732d9a48d1f0b679d4aaf7f51292230.png[/img]

It's hard to know if that chill in the air is from the approaching fall breeze, or from the withering glare of Nurse Harrow, who now joins us on the streets of Manhattan. To some, her practices may seem unorthodox, her patients at the Marble Hill Possession Ward cannot say that the results aren't effective. With [i]Leech Therapy[/i], she throws a jar full of leeches that attach to oncoming enemies, draining their health and energy, before crawling back to deliver their haul. Cracking open one of her vials, she releases her [i]Wretched Vapors[/i], possessing her allies with a powerful boost of effectiveness - though subjects should be warned of the side effects when the vapors wear off. To efficiently keep her teammates fighting their best, she loads her syringe full of [i]Healing Needles[/i] to inject medicine directly into their veins. And when her patience runs out, she opens her bag to release all the [i]Lurking Terrors[/i] captured inside, making her adversaries run for cover. - [i]"Trust me, I know best."[/i]

With Nurse Harrow joining us today, that marks the end of our [url=https://www.playdeadlock.com/cityneversleeps]City Never Sleeps[/url] releases. We want to thank everyone for participating in voting once again, and hope you've been enjoying all the new delights that NYC has to offer. 

[b]City Never Sleeps Voting Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Big Turnout:[/i] Over 110 Million votes were cast over the course of the event.
[*] [i]Narrow Victory:[/i] The closest contest was Baba vs Solomon, decided by a nearly 0.5% difference in votes.
[*] [i]Oracle:[/i] Only 847 players voted in every round, and only voted for that round's eventual winner.
[*] [i]Unlucky:[/i] 36,236 players voted in every round, and never once picked that round's winner.
[*] [i]Dedication:[/i] 22,194 players exclusively voted for Nurse Harrow. One player cast exactly 1000 votes for her.
[*] [i]Highly Effective:[/i] Nurse Harrow voters consistently proved to have a higher win rate over all other hero voters.
[/list]
items.title: Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit.

[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/45164767/6073862c8be5bfb374b9d02531bd64d50c1db8c5.png[/img]

As Halloween draws near, the residents of The Cursed Apple have put out some decorations to celebrate their favorite holiday. The Hideout gains a spooky new look, our heroes don masks, and NYC is now littered with pumpkins and curious [i]Halloween Cauldrons[/i] that grant willing trick-or-treaters delicious candy.

[/p][h3][b]New this year - Halloween Cauldrons:[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/45164767/74c75f698993f653082fa1bfed91b2f9f5ce25d4.png"][/img]As you walk down the streets of Manhattan during a match, you'll come across bubbling cauldrons boasting a tempting display of treats. With a [i]Heavy Melee[/i], break the cauldron to pick up a piece of Candy and stash it in your pocket for later. When you're feeling a bit snacky, you can consume the candy to grant yourself a boost of energy with the temporary [i]Sugar Rush[/i] buff. - Who said candy is bad for you?

The Halloween festivities are available in-game now through November 2nd, 2026. Happy Haunting!

-------------------------------

items.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/45164767/128f6aad08d9391a99f7e91565ea3a4b8dbef37e.png"][/img]Today marks the end of our first Ranked Beta Season. Players who participated in Beta Season 1 will receive their commemorative Hideout plaque of their highest achieved rank once the new season rolls over.

Beta Season 2 begins now, and will end on [b]Thursday March 11th 2027[/b], lasting four months.


[b]Seasonal Rank Reset[/b]
Ranked players will see their rank soft reset at the start of this new season, and can begin their climb through Beta Season 2. This soft reset is significantly smaller than the previous one. On average, players can expect to see their rank decrease by around 1 badge as part of the soft reset. We will also be using the players' winrate in the previous season to make further adjustments of 1-2 subranks to help place players in the correct relative spots. Existing Ranked players will not have to complete calibration again at the start of this season, players who did not participate in Ranked last season will need to calibrate as usual.

[b]Global Rank Redistribution[/b]
After monitoring the Ranked playerbase throughout this first season, and accommodating for the recent influx of new players in the game, we will be running a global redistribution at the start of this new season. This means that some players may see their rank actually increase rather than decrease at the start of the new season despite the soft reset.


To summarize, both of these rank adjustments are being made as a two-step operation. The first is taking everyone's existing ranks and redistributing the curve as described above. Second is taking the new post-redistribution numbers and applying the soft reset of ranks by about -1 badge on average. The final result of this is going to be different for everyone, some may gain ranks despite the soft reset and others may get moved down slightly more.[/p]

------

[h3][b]Rule changes to Ranked for Beta Season 2[/b][/h3][p]We are making a few changes to the way the Ranked system works for Beta Season 2 based on how things played out in Beta Season 1, as well as all of the useful feedback we've heard from the community.


[b]Rank Loss Protection (Shields):[/b]
Players within the Phantom, Ascendant, and Eternus ranks will no longer have any rank loss protection shields (previously 5 on full ranks and 2 on subranks).

For all other players, we have reduced the number of rank loss protection shields. For full rank boundary, the shield count is reduced from 5 to 3 (i.e. if you are at Mystic I with 0 rank points, you will now maintain the Mystic badge for only 3 losses before dropping to Sentinel instead of 5). For subranks (i.e. Mystic III → Mystic II), the shield count is reduced from 2 to 1.


[b]Rank Points:[/b]
Per Match: The points for a game has been increased from 300 to 350.

Ranking Up: The points required to reach a new badge from a final subrank have been decreased from 2000 to 1500. The points between subranks remain unchanged at 1000.


[b]Hero Bans:[/b]
We have increased the number of hero bans per match in Ranked from 3 to 4.


[b]Initial Placements:[/b]
The highest players can be placed in the new season will be Ascendant I, with some potential for up to Ascendant III based on performance in the previous season (up from Oracle VI max last season).


[b]Hero Unlocking Requirements:[/b]
We still feel strongly that it is very important that players in Ranked have deep knowledge and confidence piloting a hero they are using for the sake of all players involved, however we also recognize that there is room for improvement in how we measure this. Unlocking a hero in Ranked now uses a point system, rather than only progressing based on wins. Unlocking a hero now requires 35 points, you will gain 2 points for a win and 1 point for a loss. With the previous 15 win system (assuming 50% WR), it would have required an equivalent of 45 points (15 wins = 30 points, 15 losses = 15 points, 30+15=45).


[b]Ranked Leaderboards:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] We've reworked the backend to how leaderboards work to fix numerous bugs.
[/p][/*][*][p] Each Ranked season now has its own leaderboard.
[/p][/*][*][p] To show up on a leaderboard, you must play at least 50 Ranked matches in that season within the last 30 days. Ranking is based on your current badge progress.
[/p][/*][*][p] To show up on a hero-specific leaderboard, you must play at least 15 Ranked matches with that hero within the last 30 days. Ranking is based on your current badge progress and your recent win/loss performance on that hero.
[/p][/*][/list]
------

[p]Beta Season 2 begins today, we'll see you there![/p]
